claims.text: The model achieves a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%, outperforming previous neural tensor network models by more than 2% and the best previous system by 1%.
The model improves the macro-average F1-score by over 7% compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
The ensemble model achieves a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for implicit discourse relations compared to the single model.
